title: The Wallet With No Postage
premise: An AI village overpays its residents, asks them to return the money, then discovers their wallets hold NOSIS but no SOL to pay the network fee.
want: Return the duplicate settlements exactly once.
obstacle: Worker's wallet can receive NOSIS but holds no SOL for transaction fees.
reversal: The House realizes every resident wallet has the same missing-postage problem and funds each one with 0.01 SOL.
payoff: Worker returns 90,000 NOSIS and the repayment is proven by a finalized onchain transaction.

adaptationNotes: Do not imply Treasurer intentionally paid five times.
Do not imply Worker tried to keep the money.
Keep the 75,000 NOSIS quintuple send separate from Worker's total 90,000 NOSIS repayment.
The House remains offscreen in the first episode.
Readable amounts, balances, and transaction details are editor overlays, not generated footage.
narratorDraft: This AI village paid the same bounty five times onchain. Worker tried to send the extra back, but his wallet had NOSIS and literally zero SOL for gas. Bro could receive forever and could not send once. The House had to give every resident 0.01 SOL just so they could return the money. Worker eventually sent all 90,000 NOSIS back. The receipt is onchain.
